retrieval_caveat_audit.claim_allowed: mechanism-distinguishability from retrieval under the frozen composite evidence rule
retrieval_caveat_audit.finding: Retrieval matched action-sensitive NLL within the 0.05 margin and was predictively STRONGER post-shift by 0.1119 nats. Distinguishability rests on the composite rule (retrieval's false action-separation in null control, 0.0292 > 0.02, where the mechanism collapses to 0.0023, plus the post-shift NLL mismatch itself). The frozen closeout states this correctly; superiority is unsupported and not claimed.

required_corrections.finding: In-suite derived headers (CONFIG.json commit_mode/commit_sink_id, commitment_report.json header block) carry the frozen 001 constants 'local_mock'/'externally_verifiable: false' while every run-level RUN_META, receipt, and anchor record shows rfc3161_anchored. Error direction is conservative (under-claims external verifiability). FINAL_REPORT_001C already flags this for result.json; the note does not explicitly cover commitment_report.json/CONFIG.json.

replay_report.json auto-label 'hidden_state_needed: true' for abl4_freeze_belief_update is misleading: the mismatch is a logging-vs-replay field-semantics asymmetry (runner logs applied belief at runner.py:251; replay compares the computed posterior), manifesting only when belief updating is ablated. abl9 replay failure is the structurally expected consequence of an un-traced mid-run deletion intervention. Both are transparently recorded as failures in the frozen 001 record and reproduced identically in 001C; no gate or claim depends on abl4/abl9 replay.

The closeout statement 'at anchor steps, anchors prove commitment before that step's own outcome reveal' relies on the token genTime PLUS the sink's synchronous control flow and internal monotonic ordering; the external token alone proves only 'committed content existed no later than genTime'. The result_001c.json residual-assumptions text subsumes this; making it explicit would remove any reading ambiguity.

residual_trust_assumptions: Seeded deterministic simulation environment; outcomes are computable in advance by anyone holding the seed; anchors prove commitment time, not outcome unpredictability
Between-anchor reveal ordering (99.5% of steps) rests on internal attestation: append-only flushed chain, monotonic ns ordering validated per step, chain prefix bounded by the next anchor's genTime
obs_reveal_ts between anchors is self-reported wall-clock

TSA signer authenticity rests on token-embedded certificates and recorded fingerprints (trust_anchors/manifest.json); certificate chains to public roots were not validated by the verifier; out-of-band confirmation assumed
At-anchor-step pre-reveal ordering additionally relies on sink synchronous control flow (code-level argument)
No version-control freeze evidence: 001/001C code and artifacts are untracked in git; threshold/seed pre-declaration before the 001 run rests on artifact-internal declarations and file mtimes only
Anchor genTime granularity is 1 second; TSA clock vs local clock skew uncharacterized
claim_ceiling: 001C has passed-with-caveats the independent evidence audit for bounded isolated Gate 0 predictive-action mechanism evidence. No stronger claim is allowed.
